equivalence_condition: J^pi == "0+" for the even-even symmetry class.
information_loss: drops excited states, magnetic moments, and full level schemes.

ordered_parameter.declaration: ordered by increasing (A, Z): H-1, H-2, He-4, Li-7, C-12

recurrence_mapping: Ground-state spin-parity J^pi: H-1 1/2+, H-2 1+, He-4 0+, Li-7 3/2-, C-12 0+. The value 0+ recurs for even-even, paired, closed-shell nuclei He-4 and C-12; odd-mass nuclei take half-integer spins.
